references.reference_name: 新哨 20 t/day Tool 7 canonical layout
references.source_storage: canonical original input in P0A fixture directory; no original drawing PDF supplied in P0B
references.cold_room_grouping_pattern: Owner's negative review describes a fragmented, tile-like organization; current P0A evidence has no calibrated semantic cold-room grouping metric.
references.sorting_packaging_role: Owner review reports auxiliary/support rooms attached around the sorting/packing core in multiple directions, weakening a clear main/branch hierarchy.
references.raw_side_organization: Owner review reports weak receiving-to-processing direction; route-aggregated raw-side evidence is unavailable in the v2.2.1 result contract.
references.finished_side_organization: Owner review reports weak finished/shipping direction; no direction metric is available in the historical result contract.
references.packaging_material_branch_pattern: Branch quality is not machine-classified in P0A; the Owner's overall review reports main/side-flow organization concerns.
references.secondary_fruit_branch_pattern: P0A does not provide authoritative main-flow crossing facts for the secondary/frozen branches; value remains unavailable.
references.personnel_zone_relationship: Personnel placement is part of the future separation contract; the historical result lacks an accepted personnel/logistics separation fact.
references.major_zone_axis_pattern: P0A's exact structured-result calculation measured major-zone grid alignment at 0.4; this is a recorded fact, not a threshold.
references.exterior_projection_pattern: P0A measured bounding-rectangle occupancy 0.5792454589543597230802131883 and 16 reflex corners on one connected authoritative footprint polygon; notch/appendage classifiers remain unavailable.
qualitative_findings: Owner-labelled negative sample: the accepted 20 t/day production call passed engineering hard validation but failed regularity review.
Owner review describes a tile-like composition, weak main-process direction, irregular auxiliary attachment, and weak shipping orientation.
Structured P0A evidence records 0.4 major-zone grid alignment and approximately 0.579245 bounding-rectangle occupancy; neither value alone defines acceptance.
Backtrack count, route turns, depth alignment, branch crossings, and personnel/logistics separation are unavailable, not zero.

positive_vs_xinzhao_negative_comparison.xinzhao_negative_pattern: Owner review reports weak receiving-to-processing-to-shipping direction; P0A route-order evidence is unavailable.
positive_vs_xinzhao_negative_comparison.algorithm_implication: Bind semantic process roles and direction explicitly; evaluate ordered authoritative portal/corridor routes rather than infer direction from room centroids.

positive_vs_xinzhao_negative_comparison.positive_pattern: No authoritative route trace can be recovered from any reference PDF; visible bands are only qualitative organization evidence.
positive_vs_xinzhao_negative_comparison.xinzhao_negative_pattern: Owner describes the main flow as folding/backtracking; P0A has no route-aggregated backtrack metric.
positive_vs_xinzhao_negative_comparison.algorithm_implication: Implement a route-based rank-boundary re-entry metric and keep all reference-image backtrack values UNAVAILABLE.

positive_vs_xinzhao_negative_comparison.algorithm_implication: Count turns only from concatenated authoritative routes; permit documented site-constrained exceptions.

owner_positive_common_rules.rule_description: Keep the primary production organization legible as a continuous band or a central process core; avoid treating all rooms as independent peer rectangles.
owner_positive_common_rules.evidence_limit: Qualitative pattern only; not a geometric hard constraint or a project template.

owner_positive_common_rules.rule_description: Group repeated cold/storage functions into coherent aligned banks or bands, with the principal process spaces still identifiable.
owner_positive_common_rules.evidence_limit: The drawings support grouping as a visual organization principle; they do not establish counts, distances, or required dimensions.

owner_positive_common_rules.rule_description: Prefer a limited, repeated orthogonal axis family for major room boundaries where site and fixed geometry permit.
owner_positive_common_rules.evidence_limit: Site-constrained geometry and engineering dimensions always outrank visual alignment.

owner_positive_common_rules.rule_description: Keep support and material/by-product functions recognizable as local side groups instead of allowing them to obscure the primary processing organization.
owner_positive_common_rules.evidence_limit: The individual branch topology differs by project; only the distinction between core and support is common.

owner_positive_common_rules.rule_description: Prefer one coherent principal building composition, while allowing a purposeful L shape, irregular-site response, or subordinate annex when business/site authority requires it.
owner_positive_common_rules.evidence_limit: A rectangle is not a universal mandate; Mouding is explicit evidence against forcing every project into the same outline.

steps.rule: Generate candidate compositions by semantic functional group and process band before resolving individual zone rectangles.
Bind present process roles and project-specific receiving direction explicitly; do not infer receiving from truck_entrance.
Reject or mark PROCESS_FLOW_VALIDATED=false when authoritative route evidence proves reversed process rank or backtracking; missing route facts remain UNAVAILABLE.
Prefer aligned major-zone axis families and compatible depth families only after all area, dimension, access, site, and truck hard constraints pass.
Treat packaging, secondary-product, and frozen-product movements as side branches; preserve the existing packaging straight-only rule and score branch crossing only from authoritative route geometry.
Keep office/changing roles outside the product-process rank chain and evaluate personnel/logistics separation as its own quality fact.
Use versioned outline classifiers that distinguish a simple L, stair-step, narrow neck, isolated appendage, and site-constrained exception; do not equate every reflex corner with failure.
Rank only hard-feasible, P2D-full-pass candidates with a deterministic lexicographic atomic quality vector; never use a weighted total to offset a failed gate.
Return WHY_THIS_CANDIDATE_WON with atomic facts and the first decisive comparison against the next-ranked full-pass candidate.
Require explicit Owner review for irregular sites, omitted process stages, conflicting loading/receiving directions, and any rule exception not derivable from project authority.

blockers: Owner-positive references are visual-only and do not provide structured positive layout geometry for calculating depth, outline, route, or appendage metrics.
Depth-pair eligibility and exterior-notch/isolated-appendage classifiers still require versioned definitions and structured positive/negative samples.
